paragraphs: R. Yehudah bar Chanina: Yesh Nochalin—I have not found this. Eruvin, chapter 1, 11b, beginning, refers to Resh Lakish’s teacher. Rashi there identifies him as R. Yehudah son of R. Chanina. Resh Lakish spoke in his name: Ketubot 49b; Jerusalem Ketubot, chapter 4, halakhah 8; Peah, chapter 1, halakhah 1, several laws. A man angered him, and Resh Lakish fined him a litra of gold: Jerusalem Talmud, HaChovel, halakhah 8. R. Yehudah bar Chanina said to Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua: Menachot 46a. Rav Yehudah bar Chinena raised a contradiction for Rav Huna son of R. Yehoshua: Bava Kamma 14b. How could Resh Lakish's teacher speak with Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua, Rava's student, when much time separated them? Even if Rav Huna lived long, how could Resh Lakish's teacher raise a contradiction for Rava's student? There is also Rav Yitzchak bar Chanina.
